name: Terraform AWS Inline Diff Analyzer
summary: Analyze Terraform AWS plan JSON to separate inline or repeated-block diff noise from real changes in listener rules, WAFv2 web ACLs, security groups, and route tables.
security_notes: Advisory analysis only. Use this skill to triage Terraform AWS inline-block churn, but do not treat its output as approval for apply, destroy, or state mutation. Inline route or security-group rules can conflict with standalone Terraform resources, and WAFv2 inline rules have documented ordering limitations.
